铁柱沉默，王卓在一旁讥讽道：“这小子我早就说了，没那块料，现在可好，白白去丢人显眼，我是第一次测试就被收取了，没看到他后面几次测试，不过听说是三项测试没一个合格的，早听我的，都不如不去，我约莫四叔家的虎子去都比他强。”
铁柱的四叔，眉头一皱，喝道：“王卓，即便你成为仙人，也别在我面前放肆。我家虎子有没有那块料，该你屁事，没大没小的。”
王卓目中寒光一闪，冷笑几句没有说话。
铁柱的父亲，一下子似乎苍老了十多岁，瘫坐在椅子上。铁柱母亲，也是怔住了，似乎不敢相信，问道：“铁柱……是……是真的么？”
铁柱紧咬下唇，浑不在意鲜血留下，噗通一声跪在地上，重重的磕了几个头，低声说道：“爹，娘，铁柱没被仙人收入，对不起你们……我……我来生再报你们养育之恩。”
铁柱他娘察觉到自己孩子语气的绝望，立刻跑过去，把铁柱抱起，呜咽道：“娃儿，没事，不用难过，不就是没被仙人收入么，等明年咱们去县里大考，也是一样，娃儿，你可千万别做傻事，想开点，你爹和娘以后还指望你送终呢。”
铁柱他爹此时也恢复过来，看着铁柱的神情，内心一震，连忙过去抱着铁柱，焦急的说道：“铁柱，你可别做傻事，一切有爹呢，听爹的话，咱回家好好读书，明年大考也是一样。”
四周的亲戚，一个个嘴脸变的极快，纷纷远离铁柱爹娘，脸上均露出看热闹的神态，闲言碎语，议论纷纷。
“铁柱这孩子，我之前就觉得不行，他怎么能和大哥家的王卓比啊，这次算是丢人丢到家了。”铁柱父亲的六弟，嘲讽道。
“就是，早知道是这样，就别弄的好像真的被收入似的，多丢人啊，老二，你都这么大年纪的人了，怎么尽办些蠢事，难怪当初你爹没把家产分给你。”铁柱父亲的三叔，面露厌恶之色，讥讽道。
“要我说，这孩子从小聪明这事，十有八九是假的，估计是老二觉得自己这辈子没啥出息，所以把自己娃娃一顿吹嘘，现在可好，被揭穿了吧。”刚才坐在铁柱父亲身边的五叔，嘴脸立刻变换，一改刚才阿谀之色。
“三个娃娃去测试，就他一人儿失败，铁柱这孩子，是咱们王家最差的一个了，丢人啊，二嫂子啊，刚才我还说你和二哥在一起享福，现在一看，你这辈子也就这样了，没那个福气。”女眷中有人嘲讽道。
“可不是么，前几天我还去他们村里看到铁柱了，当时我就寻思着这孩子傻啦吧唧的，怎么能和王卓和王浩那两个娃娃比，准成不了。”铁柱的五叔嫂，也换上嘴脸，讥讽起来。
“我早就看出铁柱这娃娃不行，你们看看他爹他娘，就那样还能生出个什么好娃子呢，咱们王家，也就大哥和老三家的孩子有出息，铁柱，呸，就这名字看起来就傻里傻气的。”女眷中另一人，也不甘落后嘲讽道。
“我刚才是瞎了眼了，还要把自己闺女往火坑里推，幸好这铁柱没被仙人收入，不然我闺女以后还不得恨我一辈子啊，铁柱他娘，亲家这事，咱就这么算了，你家娃娃既然当不成仙人，谁会把闺女许给他啊，这不是癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉么。”
一时之间，几乎所有的亲戚都一个个露出势利的嘴脸，各种恶毒的话语越来越严重，无情的打击着铁柱一家人。
这一幕，与刚才的奉承相比，天地之差。更有甚者，干脆撕破脸皮直接开口就索要之前赠送的礼品，听的铁柱爹娘面无血色，王林握紧了拳头，内心的伤痛，更加剧烈，他仿佛有一种要死了的感觉，耳边传来的尽是嘲讽的话语。
王卓的父亲，内心冷笑，漫不经心的说道：“老二，之前我就说了，仙人收徒讲究缘分，要求很严格的，除非像我儿子这样优秀，否则根本就没有半点机会，你可倒好，还真当回事了，现在弄得孩子都绝望的活不下去了，何必呢？”

铁柱的父亲忍无可忍，猛的回头，怒目而视，喝道：“王天山，你给我住口，当年爹临终前明明把家产留给我一份，你费尽苦心联系亲戚抢走我那份，今天还在这里冷嘲热讽，你真当我王天水没血性么！

Tie Zhu was silent, and Wang Zhuo sarcastically said: "I told you this kid a long time ago that he didn't have that material, so now it's okay to go and embarrass himself in vain. I was taken in for the first test, and I didn't see him in the next few tests, but I heard that none of the three tests passed. If you had listened to me earlier, it would be better not to go. I asked the tigers in my fourth uncle's family to go there and be better than him."
Tiezhu's fourth uncle frowned and shouted: "Wang Zhuo, even if you become an immortal, don't be presumptuous in front of me. Whether my tiger son has that piece of material is none of your business, no matter how big or small."
Wang Zhuo's eyes flashed coldly, he sneered and said nothing.
Tie Zhu's father suddenly seemed to have aged more than ten years, slumped in his chair. Tiezhu's mother was also stunned, as if she couldn't believe it, and asked: "Is Tiezhu...is...is it true?"
Tie Zhu bit his lower lip tightly, not caring about the blood left behind. He knelt on the ground with a thud, kowtowed a few times, and whispered: "Father, mother, Tie Zhu was not taken in by the immortal. I'm sorry to you... I... I will repay your kindness in raising me in the next life."
Tie Zhu's mother noticed the despair in her child's tone, and immediately ran over, picked up Tie Zhu, and sobbed: "My dear, it's okay, don't be sad, it's just that I didn't get accepted by the immortal. It will be the same when we go to the county for the big exam next year. My dear, please don't do anything stupid, be considerate, your father and mother will still count on you to die in the future."
Tie Zhu's father also recovered at this time. Looking at Tie Zhu's expression, he was shocked in his heart. He quickly went over to hug Tie Zhu and said anxiously: "Tie Zhu, don't do anything stupid. Dad is responsible for everything. Listen to dad, let's go home and study hard. The same will be true for next year's exam."
The faces of the relatives around them changed very quickly, and they all moved away from Tiezhu's father and mother, with expressions of watching the excitement on their faces, and they were chatting and talking.
"I thought this kid Tiezhu was not good enough before. How could he compete with Wang Zhuo from his eldest brother's family? This time he is completely embarrassed." Tiezhu's father's sixth brother mocked.
"That's right, if I had known this to be the case, I wouldn't have acted as if I was really being paid. How embarrassing, my second brother, you are already so old, why do you do stupid things? No wonder your father didn't give you the family property back then." Tiezhu's father's third uncle sarcastically said with a look of disgust on his face.
"If you ask me, the fact that this kid has been smart since he was a child is most likely a lie. It's probably because the second child felt that he had no future, so he bragged about it. Now, it's been exposed." Uncle Wu, who was sitting next to Tiezhu's father, immediately changed his expression and changed from the flattering look he had just shown.
"Three children went to the test, and he was the only one who failed. This child, Tiezhu, is the worst one in our Wang family. It's so shameful. Second sister-in-law, I just said that you and your second brother are enjoying happiness together. Now, looking at it, you will be like this for the rest of your life. You won't have that blessing." Someone among the female relatives mocked.
"Isn't it? I went to their village a few days ago and saw Tiezhu. At that time, I was thinking about how this kid is so stupid. How can he compare with those two kids Wang Zhuo and Wang Hao? He is definitely not successful." Tiezhu's fifth uncle and sister-in-law also changed their faces and started sarcastically.
"I've long seen that Tiezhu is not good. Look at his father and his mother. How can a good child be born like this? In our Wang family, only the children of the eldest brother and the third family are promising. Tiezhu, bah, just the name looks silly." Another one of the female relatives was not to be outdone and mocked.
"I was blind just now, and I had to push my daughter into the fire pit. Fortunately, the iron pillar was not captured by the immortal. Otherwise, my daughter would have to hate me for the rest of her life. Iron pillar, mother, let's just forget about the in-laws. Since your baby can't be regarded as an immortal, who will treat my daughter like an immortal?The girl promised him, isn't this a toad wanting to eat swan meat? "
Suddenly, almost all the relatives showed snobbish faces, and all kinds of vicious words became more and more serious, hitting Tie Zhu's family mercilessly.
Compared with the flattery just now, this scene is a world of difference. What's more, he simply broke his face and asked for the gift he had given before. Tiezhu's father and mother's faces turned pale when they heard this. Wang Lin clenched his fists, and the pain in his heart became more intense. He seemed to feel like he was about to die, and all the sarcastic words came to his ears.
Wang Zhuo's father sneered in his heart and said nonchalantly: "Second son, I have said before that immortals pay attention to fate when recruiting disciples and have very strict requirements. Unless they are as outstanding as my son, there is no chance at all. It's a good thing that you really take it seriously. Now the children are so desperate that they can't live anymore. Why bother?" "
Tiezhu's father couldn't bear it any longer, turned back sharply, glared angrily, and shouted: "Wang Tianshan, shut up! Before my father died, he clearly left me a share of the family property. You took great pains to contact your relatives to steal my share, and you are still here today to ridicule me. Do you really think that I, Wang Tianshui, are bloodless!"
